[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Task link marks — status rings on links that point to tasks[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]Every rendered link whose target is a `#task` line wears a small [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]status ring (Ready, Next, In Progress, Blocked, Done, Cancelled) in[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]Live Preview and rendered views, so Bryan can tell at a glance [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]which links point to tasks and what state those tasks are in. Links[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]to notes, headings, and non-task blocks stay exactly as they are, [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]nothing is ever written to the vault, and a session toggle restores[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]plain links.[/#D7D7AF]

[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Contract, pure core, ring glyphs, and visual preview[/bold #D7AFFF]          [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
